status: Human-requested small-pilot design, no launch/criterion approval
human_direction: Design something smaller that might need about30minutes of computer AI runtime. Interpreted conservatively as proposed whole-session ceiling, not30minutes of extra calls or launch authorization.

selection.rule: First (lowest frozen priority) T49 primary per part; do not inspect scores or reselect. These remain the original top1 of the same full frame.

primary_frame.encoding: source-order compact sorted-key UTF8 JSON metadata rows + newline; row fields are selection-record fields before split/priority additions
primary_frame.population_limit: Nonempty OCR paragraphs only; missing print outside OCR is unmeasured. Blank pages counted, not assigned to nonempty-paragraph estimates.

selection.subset_inclusion: 1/N_h under the original uniform-priority model; N_h expansion weight. One unit per part cannot estimate within-part design variance. Only descriptive provisional counts, no corpus accuracy/safety/recall inference.
selection.confirmation: All10 T49 confirmation identities remain unused, text withheld. No new confirmation selected.
selection.exposure: T49 primary was already materialized; known/unknown exposure carried forward. Two challenge audits deliberately exposed. No fresh/held-out evidence claim.
selection.larger_design: T49 bytes and prospective two-reader reference design preserved unchanged; deferred as an initial-runtime requirement, not erased or treated as approved.

runtime.hard_input_accounting: Actual model/image token fit must be measured or rigorously bounded in T55; unknown input/image usage blocks launch. These proposed limits are not measured counts.
runtime.local_provider: Preferred installed image-capable Qwen candidate only, exact runtime/model digest and capability rechecked in T55; no model substitution/download. Same model for both primary passes avoids switching but creates correlated errors.
runtime.compatibility_warmup_calls: Included in the12-call/time envelope, never additional. Any necessary unscheduled call needs revised frozen readiness; no free trial.
runtime.deadline: Start clock before fresh checks/model loading/image acquisition. Before each send require remaining global time≥120seconds+30seconds terminal/report reserve, remaining request budget≥120seconds, and a free fixed slot. Use minimum120/global/request remaining timeout. Stop on deadline,budget,invalid/refusal/incomplete response,timeout,unknown usage,wrong/missing image or incompatible identity; no replacements/retries.
runtime.setup_overrun: If readiness/images/token fit consume more than360seconds, do not launch a reduced/adaptive request list; mark session not_ready and stop. If overhead/processing later consumes deadline reserve, stop with partial coverage.
runtime.cancellation_limit: Client deadlines/transport timeout are not proven server-compute cancellation. T53/T55 must establish owned-request stop/observation behavior before claiming a hard30minute computer shutdown. On ambiguous timeout do not launch another request; retain unknown backend consumption and reconcile logs/process state. Current design is a bounded dispatch/wait proposal, not proof of backend cancellation.
runtime.completion: A partial/nonready terminal report is a valid feasibility outcome, not a completed seven-unit quality evaluation.

materials.text_policy: Whole targets only; primary context included complete under2000codepoints or omitted, never silently clipped. Reuse exact T49 source text/static hashes and frozen saved challenge source/proposal identities. Oversize/missing/unclear image =>unresolved and stop; no easier replacement.
materials.images: Five probability targets currently have no bound image. Two historical challenge bindings are recorded but must be reverified. New fetches,if separately authorized in readiness, count against total session/bytes and have no automatic retries. More than one required crop per unit blocks this small design; do not silently weaken coverage.

historical_timing.interpretation: Earlier different-input calls only. Median~69seconds suggests12calls may fit24request-minutes, but two prior timeouts and changed images/prompts prohibit a completion guarantee. Loading/preparation were not fully included in those per-attempt durations.

reference_and_claims.AI_comparison: Image-only observation frozen before repair/audit pass; second request receives no first response. Host compares raw/static/derived text against provisional observation and preserves disagreement/uncertainty. Combined repair/audit is one configuration, not a separately validated auditor.
reference_and_claims.independence: Separate prompts do not make same-model errors independent. Agreement is not gold. No human reading is required/requested for this diagnostic, and no AI answer becomes human-approved text.
reference_and_claims.measure_now_if_later_run: Actual valid/invalid/timeout/partial counts; exact proposal anchors/edits; provisional name/number/word discrepancies and disagreements; apparent-success/negative-text coverage; detection/repair/audit work; calls,time,tokens,image bytes,unknown usage and setup/report costs.
unavailable_without_independent_referenc: Population detector/auditor recall and false-alarm rates
Human readability/TTS and downstream quality acceptance
reference_and_claims.human_effort: Zero new human review requested; preserve HR-009/010 unchanged. Larger independent reference effort is deferred, not silently approved or performed. Escalate a future small decision-changing dispute only through separately authorized concrete review scope.
reference_and_claims.stop_decision: Use outcome to choose specific contract/runtime/grounding fix or whether an independently checked larger sample is worthwhile. Do not choose final P0 method or authorize full corpus cleanup.

authorization.next_steps: T50 contracts must support image-only observation versus quote-bound combined repair/audit; T51 workflow adoption if applicable; T52/T53 fake/offline implementation; T55 exact finite readiness and actual authorization before T56.
